Players Committee errata-sheet panel for [[Blast The Door, Kid!]]. Source: [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|complete official Decipher Errata sheet]] ([[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|download the complete PDF]]), cover edition “Official text as of June 1, 2017”, original PDF page 24, Blast The Door, Kid! panel at the top of the left column. The cover edition is not an established first-publication day.

The actual composed PDF rectangle (35.99399948120117,46.524017333984375)–(214.86599731445312,130.35601806640625) was rendered at 745/rectangle-width pixels per point with no alpha channel. All text and marks in the region are retained; the external unnumbered E and comma after “for remainder of battle” are printed by the source. This is a PDF rasterization, not an extracted background alone or a physical-card scan.

Original card design by Decipher; errata-sheet rendition by the Players Committee. The lower partial does not print the full card's copyright strip. Used to identify and discuss published card designs on this non-commercial fan wiki.
